svg.text: DIAGRAM 3: FIVE FLEX SENSORS - five independent voltage dividers
Each branch: 3.3V > flex sensor > NODE > 10k > GND. The green ADC wire leaves the node only.
Green arcs = wires crossing WITHOUT touching. The five nodes are never joined.
Breadboard prototype only: the 3V3 pin is
under the ESP32 body, so the rail is fed from
D33 (GPIO33 = HIGH). See Section 6. On the
glove perfboard use the real 3V3 pin.
